faqs.question: Who should take this Data Analysis course?
faqs.answer: This is for anyone who wants to turn raw data into real business decisions — including business professionals, finance officers, administrators, and complete beginners with basic computer skills who are ready to learn Excel, SQL, and Power BI from the ground up.

faqs.question: Can I pay for just one step instead of the whole course?
faqs.answer: Yes! You can start with just one step for as little as ₦12,000. Each step has its own price, and you can add more whenever you're ready. If you're able to take the full course at once, it works out cheaper (₦140,000 instead of ₦163,000 if bought step by step) — but starting small is always an option.

faqs.question: Can I pick any step, or do I have to go in order?
faqs.answer: We recommend going in order, since several steps build directly on the Excel, SQL, and Power BI skills from earlier ones. You're still free to start wherever you like — if you skip ahead, we'll let you know clearly what you might want to brush up on first.

faqs.question: What's the difference between a Step Certificate and the Full Course Certificate?
faqs.answer: Every step you complete earns its own Digitanotion Step Certificate. Once you've completed all 8 steps, you also receive the Digitanotion Data Analysis Professional Certificate, recognised by our industry partners as full course completion.

faqs.question: What if I only finish a few steps? Do I lose anything?
faqs.answer: Not at all. You keep every Step Certificate you've earned, and you can come back and continue at any time — there's no deadline or expiry on picking up where you left off.

faqs.question: Do I need prior experience in data analysis?
faqs.answer: No. This course is designed to start from the fundamentals of Excel and SQL, gradually building up to advanced Power BI dashboards. All you need is analytical thinking and a willingness to learn.

faqs.question: Why Power BI over other visualization tools?
faqs.answer: Power BI is the market leader in business intelligence, used by the majority of Fortune 500 companies. It's free for desktop use, integrates seamlessly with Excel and SQL Server, and has strong, growing job demand across Nigeria's data analytics market.

faqs.question: What SQL Server will I learn?
faqs.answer: You'll learn SQL Server Express — the free, fully-featured database engine from Microsoft. You'll master writing queries, joining tables, aggregating data, and optimizing query performance, skills essential for any data professional.

faqs.question: Do I need a powerful computer?
faqs.answer: A Windows laptop with 8GB RAM is recommended for the best experience with Power BI and SQL Server. Mac users can use Boot Camp or Parallels — we provide guidance on setup during orientation.

faqs.question: Will I have a portfolio by the end?
faqs.answer: Yes! You'll complete 5 real-world projects — sales dashboards, financial analytics, customer insights, HR analytics, and a capstone executive dashboard — that become your professional portfolio to show employers.

faqs.question: Is there job placement support for data analysts?
faqs.answer: Yes. We have partnerships with banks, telecoms, and consulting firms actively hiring data analysts. Our career support includes portfolio reviews, mock interviews, resume optimization, and direct referrals to our hiring network.

faqs.question: Is this certification recognized by employers?
faqs.answer: Yes, our Data Analysis certification is industry-recognized and valued by employers across Nigeria and Africa. Many of our graduates work as data analysts at banks, fintechs, NGOs, and multinational companies.

faqs.question: What makes this course different from online tutorials?
faqs.answer: This is a structured, mentor-led program with personalized feedback, real-world datasets, and career coaching. You don't just learn tools — you learn to think like a data analyst and solve real business problems with data.

faqs.question: What support do I get during the course?
faqs.answer: A dedicated mentor, round-the-clock access to your practice labs and datasets, a student community, weekly office hours, and career guidance once you're done.
